objectives.text: Obtain the bronze pocket watch on Customs
Obtain the key to the fuel tanker truck
Hand over the found item

items.name: Machinery key
items.notes: Unlocks the driver side door of the fuel truck cabin at Customs where the Bronze pocket watch is located.

items.name: Bronze pocket watch on a chain
items.notes:
This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.
When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.
If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.

guide.text:
Head into the map Customs. The Machinery key is required to access the bronze pocket watch. So if you do not have one, head to room 205 located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building in the south.

To enter the room you'll need to jump on top of debris blocking the hallway and crouch to get inside the doorway of the room. The Machinery key can be found within the blue jackets beside the wardrobe.

After obtaining the key, head north to the fuel tanker truck that is located at the construction site. The driver side door of the cabin can be unlocked with the Machinery key.

Inside, the Bronze pocket watch can be found laying on the floor in front of the seat. Be careful of the sniper Scav overlooking the truck from the roof of the nearby boiler building.

After picking up the pocket watch, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the pocket watch to hand it in. If you die before extraction, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the pocket watch over to Prapor to complete the quest.

guide.text:
To begin, you need to have the Tarcone Director's office key. If you do not have one, you can find it within drawers or from Scavs. It can also be bartered for with Therapist. Once you have obtained one, head to Customs. The first place you want to visit is the red Paradigm warehouse on the east side of the map. The office is found at the top of the metal stairs. After unlocking the door there will be two rooms. The second room is the one containing the documents. Be warned though, to enter this room the door must be breached, which will create a lot of noise. After entering the room, go to the desk and look just under the table top, on top of the drawers. Leaning may help you to see it. Extract from Customs. If you die at any point after picking up the documents and you still have them in your in raid quest inventory, they will be lost and must be reacquired. If you don't want to do the second part of the quest immediately, you can move the documents into your off-raid quest inventory in the character menu under the "tasks" tab.

It's time to head to Factory. You can complete this during the daytime or nighttime. With the documents in your in raid quest inventory, head towards…

guide.text:
The required room is the "Breach Room" on Factory. Place 3x Gunpowder "Kite" while night time there.
The "Breach Room" is the room between the office and the locked room on the third floor. Each Gunpowder "Kite" takes 30 seconds to place, leading to a total placement time of 90 seconds. Closing the door to the breach room is recommended while placing them, as Scavs will wander down the hallway periodically. If you wish to complete this quest with little to no resistance it is recommended to bring a squad to defend you as you plant the items. You do not have to successfully extract to complete this quest.

requirements: • Must be level 14 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find the unpowered secret exit on Reserve

guide.text:
This quest requires you to extract with the "D-2" extraction on Reserve.

First, turn on the power with a lever in the command part of the underground bunker system. Be aware, activating the lever has the chance to spawn Scav Raiders in the command part of the bunker. Then, press the button on the wall next to the sliding door at the extraction. You need to exit the raid with the "Survived" status to get the quest completion. The "Run Through" status will not complete the quest. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

guide.text:
There are multiple spawns for the V3 flash drive at the black (southern) chalet on Lighthouse. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper.

Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed.

guide.text: In this quest you first have to find the Incriminating letter on the third floor in the northern building of the industrial plant on Customs. Afterwards you have to transit to Reserve and stash it on the third floor of the military headquarters (Black Bishop). Next you have to transit to Woods and kill any 3 targets there. Lastly you need to transit to Lighthouse and launch a yellow flare at the train station and the pier, and extract. While doing these objectives, 10 Scavs also need to be killed. Dying or extracting at any point before completing all objectives will reset fulfilled objectives besides collecting the Incriminating letter.

guide.text:
• A high amount of Tushonka can be found inside the shopping mall on Interchange. Particularly, the "Goshan" (written "гошан" on its signs) supermarket stores a very large amount on its shelves. However, this is a hot-spot for players as many wish to take the Tushonka or loot the registers, so it should be approached with care.
• Tushonka is also commonly found in "Ration supply crates" near tanks on Reserve, however like Goshan, Reserve is a highly populated map, with many threats, so it should be approached with care.
• Tushonka and other food items are also plentiful at the camp on woods next to scav bunker in a ration supply crate and as loose loot. Farther south, USEC camp is also a good spot to find food items

• Tushonka can be crafted in the Hideout at the Nutrition unit Lvl 1.

guide.text:
In this quest you have to hand over 2 BNTI Gzhel-K body armors. One with 0-50% durability and one with 50-100% durability. The armors require no inserted armor plates since the condition is measured by the integrated soft armor.

Since friendly fire is always active, you can easily complete this quest with the help of a another player through the use of a Blicky pistol.

Another way to complete this quest solo is to let border snipers shoot you so that your character dies far outside the playable space of the map. You can insure the armor with Prapor to receive it back in roughly a day to a day and a half, but it will be quicker if you use Therapist to insure it. You may have to do this method multiple times for the same armor to get it down to the required durability.

Another option is to shoot the orange propane containers found on The Lab or Customs whilst being inside the radius. The hot gas damage will damage all parts of your armour, this will however also deal a lot of body damage and may kill you if you are not being careful. It is best not to stand directly next to the propane while it explodes, and to only use one explosion at a time. Take in extra gear and meds to swap…

5d25aed386f77442734d25d2.title: The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs without wearing any body armor on Woods

guide.text:
In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs on Woods without wearing any armor vest or armored chest rig. Armored headwear, face cover and eyewear is allowed.

If you want to protect yourself during this quest you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a Scav. To keep yourself safe while doing this quest, you should try and remain as far away as possible from the Scavs and consider using a scoped weapon.

objectives.text: Survive for 5 minutes while suffering from complete dehydration (Excluding Factory)
Survive and extract from the location

guide.text:
You can consume certain items that decrease your hydration to quickly get into the dehydration state. For example, a Jar of DevilDog mayo gives -99 and a Can of condensed milk -65 hydration. You can also use the gym module in your hideout to drain energy and hydration before starting a raid.

Alternatively, if you play with friends, you can ask them to shoot you in the stomach, which will get you into the dehydration state too. Keep in mind that this will also decrease your energy rapidly.

Don't forget to bring enough Meds or a Propital regenerative stimulant injector to outheal the damage, and enough Drinks to continue the raid afterwards.

If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" extraction status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. If you happen to get a run through, you can survive and extract from another raid on any location to complete the quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 Scavs while suffering from pain effect

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Benelli M3 Super 90 12ga dual-mode shotgun at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks Bear Hideout shooting range target style

guide.text:
• Dehydration and broken bones cause pain. Easiest way to break your leg bones is to fall a few meters or to intentionally fail the Hideout gym training to break your arm.
◦ Using a Jar of DevilDog mayo is an easy way to achieve pain through dehydration, although it comes with the side effect of constant damage over time.
• Using painkillers, morphine and/or similar medication will remove the status effect, and as such kills will not count towards the quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 Scavs in a single raid without using any medicine on Woods

guide.text:
• Do not use any Medical items while in a raid while the quest is active.
• If you complete the objective to kill the three Scavs without healing the task will still fail if you heal before handing it in. In addition, if you complete the objectives but do not click complete with Jaeger, then healing in a later Woods raid will cause failure of the quest.
• Surviving the raid is not necessary for the quest to be completed.
• Off-raid healing does affect this quest.
• Drinkable alcohol is a painkiller that will not fail this quest.

guide.text: In this quest you have to kill Shturman from over 40 meters away with a headshot while using a Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle with a Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope. To have the kill count for this quest, the Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope just needs to be installed on the gun, and not necessarily be actively used. 639136e84ed9512be67647db.title: Cease Fire!
requirements: • Must be level 10 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov through Klimov Street

guide.text: In this quest you have to extract from Streets of Tarkov via the "Klimov Street" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen: If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Jaeger via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. guide.text:
In this quest you have to kill any 30 hostiles from a distance of over 100m with AR-15 platform weapons. You can use any of the following:
• M4A1
• ADAR 2-15
• TX-15 DML
• Radian Model 1
• M16A1
• M16A2

A recommendable spot to shoot from would be dome area on Reserve as you can get a good view of the Scav spawns around the map.

It is recommended to use a suppressor as shooting loud from this position can attract unwanted attention.

AI Scavs tend to search and loot dead bodies. For a brief moment they will be stationary whilst looting, allowing for an easy headshot kill. Killing targets out in the open will leave their bodies as bait allowing for AI or players to loot them letting you gain more kills and establishing areas of interest to shoot at.

Use a high zoom variable scope for better accuracy and non-tracer ammunition for better concealment.

guide.text: In this quest you have to extract from Customs via the "Railroad Passage" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen: If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Prapor via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. Staying on the tracks is required to not get shot.

In this quest you first have to find the Laptop from an unknown facility. Then craft the Data from Fence's laptop at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout and read it from the off-raid quest inventory. Afterwards hand over the laptop to Mechanic.
